gizmo.title: Mimhanzi yakanyorwa
gizmo.description: Inoratidza nekuridza mimhanzi yakanyorwa, mathebhu egitare, nemanyorerwo emimhanzi kuburikidza nealphaTex kana MusicXML.

configure.title: Manyorerwo eAlphaTex
configure.description: Manyorerwo ealphaTex ari mukati emimhanzi yakanyorwa. Gadzirisa pachako kunyora manotsi; anochengetwa mutemplate kuitira kuti nzvimbo dzichengetedzwe.

configure.title: Faira remimhanzi
configure.description: Isa kana batanidza kufaira reMusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) kana reGuitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Rinotsiva alphaTex iri mukati kana rasetwa.

advanced.title: Kuridza odhiyo
advanced.description: Zvinenge zvakabatidzwa - teerera mimhanzi yakanyorwa ichiridzwa nesynthesizer yakavakirwa mukati. Dzima kuti uone chete (pasina odhiyo).

advanced.title: Ratidza sarudzo dzekuratidza
advanced.description: Ratidza mabhatani ekukudza, ekutambanudza, nemarongerwo pabhawa remutambi.

advanced.title: Ratidza mabhatani ekuburitsa
advanced.description: Ratidza mabhatani ekudhaunirodha MIDI nekudhinda/PDF pabhawa remutambi.
